clean.tx: He keem na de Köök to fröhstücken.
clean.tl: He came to the kitchen to eat breakfast.

clean.tx: Mi weer de Sunn to grall bi 'n Läsen.
clean.tl: The sun was too bright for me while reading.

clean.tx: Ik mout waitn wel dat ik in hoes krieg.
clean.tl: I need to know whom I will get into the house.

clean.tx: Un dạrmit secht de ol Mann em Beschêd, wodenni as he dat maken schall.
clean.tl: And with this, the old man tells him how he should do it.

flagged.tx: As de Bur 'n Sett up Bedd wäsen weer.
flagged.tl: When the farmer had been on the bed for a moment.

flagged.tx: Hê schall mal na ehr'n Brôder Mạn gahn un fragen den' mal.
flagged.tl: He should just go to her brother moon and ask him.
